title: Paneer Rasmalai
description: A rich and creamy Indian dessert made with paneer, rasmalai and a hint of umami flavor.
instructions: Combine sugar, cardamom powder and saffron in a saucepan.
Heat the mixture over medium heat, stirring until the sugar dissolves.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the milk to the saucepan and stir well.
Add the paneer to the saucepan and stir gently.
Cook for 5-7 minutes, or until the paneer is well coated with the milk mixture.
Stir in the rasmalai and cook for a further 2 minutes.
Remove from heat and let it cool to room temperature.
Chill the mixture in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours.
Serve chilled, garnished with cardamom powder and kesar.
